content.intro: Functions are values. Parameters, returns, lexical scope and closures let you build reusable behavior; an inner function can retain access to an outer local after the outer function returns.

content_blocks.code:
local function add_bonus(score, bonus)
    return score + bonus
end

print(add_bonus(12, 3))

items.title: Mistake 1
items.text: Confusing Function Design and Reusability with a similarly named feature in another language or runtime. Fix: follow the version-matched reference and test the smallest example.

items.text: Relying on an output order or environment capability that the language/host does not guarantee. Fix: document assumptions and make order/capabilities explicit.
